decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the premises via the main entrance shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 4 - One car space for use of persons with a disability is to be provided permanently on-site. Details of the space shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the new club area is used.
Condition : 5 - Final details for the control of odours and noise from the kitchen exhaust system shall be submitted to an approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
Condition : 6 - The scheme approved under condition 5 shall be fully implemented before the kitchen is used.
Condition : 7 - The club shall only be used between the hours of 8:00am to 11:00pm.
Condition : 8 - Any restaurants, bars, lounges and other areas incidental to the snooker club shall remain ancillary to the main use and shall not be used independently of the club.
Condition : 9 - The premises shall only be used as a snooker club.
description: Change of use from car workshop to expand area of existing snooker club, erection of external ducting, internal works and alterations to existing entry of snooker club
